Aisha (CS): Quick heads up — Northbridge onboarding showing 220ms median but spikes to 1.4s on ~40% of requests after last model update. Renewal NPS slipped to 6. They're asking why latency jumped.
Priya (ML Eng): On it. Can you paste a sample request payload and tail logs? Likely long prompt + system messages causing KV cache thrash.
Aisha (CS): pasted sample: "user_prompt":"Summarize 800-word policy doc for end user" — yep long. Also they use streaming in UI.
Priya (ML Eng): Two quick levers: 1) route >512-token requests to compact-2.7B (faster, cheaper), 2) int8 quant on current model for tail reduction. We'll canary both.
Tom (Solutions): Love it. Can we do prefix caching too for repeated templates? Northbridge queries reuse same preamble.
Priya (ML Eng): Yes — enable prefix KV caching for that route. Proposed routing rule (canary):
```
route "northbridge_long" {
  match: tokens > 512
  preferred_model: compact-2.7b
  fallback: gptx-13b-int8
  traffic: 10% -> expand
}
```
Aisha (CS): ETA to run canary? They want low-risk change before renewal talk Thurs.
Priya (ML Eng): I can deploy canary today — will spin up int8 nodes and route 10% traffic. Expect tail p50->p95 drop ~300-600ms per our bench.
Ethan (Acct Lead): I'll prep a short doc to set expectations. If we hit >30% tail reduction we mention cost/latency win in renewal call.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to cluster-us-east-1: northbridge_long @ 10% — started 2024-10-03T16:42:12Z
Aisha (CS): great. Please monitor errors and quality. We'll collect 1k eval pairs for quality regression check. @Priya can you add automatic regression alert?
Priya (ML Eng): Yep — will set an eval hook and 5% quality regression alert. Also adding automatic rollback on >0.5% hallucination uptick.
Tom (Solutions): I'll schedule a short enablement session with their eng lead Tues. Share canary dashboard link.
Aisha (CS): thanks team. I'll update Northbridge and loop in renewal owner. :thumbsup:
